unique_mathematical_solution: Each of the three bottom unit squares has side1. Their combined width3 is the side of the next square. Its top is height4, so the next square has side4. The upper square spans width3+4=7, making the rectangle7 by11 and area77. All dimensions are forced by square incidences.
design_or_rejection_reason: No clean concise legal measurement-binding trap was found: all three unit-area1 labels are already clear. Making a larger square look like the area1 unit would just impose a misleading scale association with little informational need.
